title: lodash.get is deprecated
summary: npm recommends replacing lodash.get with JavaScript's optional chaining operator.

constraints: Preserve path semantics, array-index access, default-value behavior, nullish handling, and minimum-runtime support.

steps.title: Use optional chaining
steps.instructions: Rewrite each lodash.get call with optional chaining and nullish coalescing where a default value is required, then remove the dependency.

verification.purpose: Run nested access, default-value, nullish, and repository tests.
